part: plan P0c calibration: Clef against itself in the engine replay
question: What share of the engine's outputs stay inside the Step 1 noise band when Clef's reading from one question wording alone is replayed against its two-wording reading?
one_change: replace the CPU router's readings with Clef's single-wording readings in the same replay

baseline.model: best router setting in the sweep, share of engine outputs within the band

prediction.metric: share_within_band_wording0: share of engine outputs whose absolute difference between Clef's wording-0 reading and Clef's two-wording reading is at most the Step 1 noise band, 800 held-out stories
prediction.why: the best CPU router setting reached 30.6 percent in band with about 0.17 differing fired keys per story against 3.56 fired keys (computed, t212); the two wordings of one Clef read differ in more fired keys than that, because the engine averages them and a key fires only above 0.65 (computed rule in classify.py); so Clef against itself may land near or below the CPU router, and the interval is wide because this is the first measurement (estimate)
